text:
Maya Ramos: OK team — Primarbor dedicated rollout is scheduled for Thu 03:00 UTC (quiet window). I’m posting the small plan and asking for explicit thumbs from infra, oncall, and CS. https://redwood.internal/releases/primarbor-v2.1

Raj Patel: Sounds good. Can you confirm the pinned model + runtime? We need the exact image tag for the deploy bot.

Maya Ramos: Pinned to: `redwood/inference-runtime:2.1.0-primarbor` and model set `rw-primarbor-v3-q4`. Deploy bot will use the `primb-2201` slice.

Lin Chen: Noted. We ran a smoke in staging — KV cache priming looks fine. Only caveat: seq-len distribution slightly higher than avg; added a temporary batch cap `max_batch_tokens=2048`.

Priya Singh: Customer TPM (Primarbor) confirmed maintenance window and notified their DB team. They want a 30m rollback hold before traffic switch.

Owen Brooks: From CS: please make sure release notes contain the prompt template change and the embedding rerank update. I’ll paste the notes in the channel in a bit.

DeployBot: deploy request received — job #55911 queued by @Maya Ramos
DeployBot: preflight checks: infra:ok, kvm:ok, kms:conflict? (see note)

Zoe Callahan: KMS conflict — there's a scheduled rotation in us-west-2 at 03:15 UTC (auto-rotate). We should either delay the rotation or move the traffic window. I vote delay rotate by 1h.

Maya Ramos: Good catch Zoe. Priya — can Primarbor accept a rotation delay?

Priya Singh: Yes, they approved delaying rotation to 04:30 UTC. Confirming now.

Raj Patel: With rotation delayed, can we keep the original quiet window. I recommend we set rollback criteria: 1) p95 latency > 350ms sustained for 5min, 2) error rate > 1% (5min), 3) top-1 quality drop measured by eval set (automated).

Lin Chen: Adding runbook snippet for ops: ````
# rollback trigger checks
if p95_lat > 350ms for 5m: trigger rollback
if err_rate > 1% for 5m: trigger rollback
pin image: redwood/inference-runtime:2.1.0-primarbor
model: rw-primarbor-v3-q4
````

Maya Ramos: DeployBot — please include the pinned image and rollout plan in the job metadata and do a 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% over 30m with metric gates.

DeployBot: job #55911 updated: rollout_policy=canary, canary_steps=[5,25,100], metric_gates=[p95<350ms, err<1%, eval_regression<0.5%] — starting preflight in 2m.

Owen Brooks: Adding brief release-notes excerpt: "Model update: rw-primarbor-v3-q4 for improved reranking and shorter responses under long-context scenarios. Ops: fixed KV caching bug for tenant slices."

Priya Singh: Customer ack received. They asked to be paged first if canary fails.

Zoe Callahan: Oncall ack — I’ll monitor first 30m and escalate if gates trip.

Maya Ramos: Thanks — thumbs? :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: :thumbsup:
Lin Chen: :thumbsup:
Owen Brooks: :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: :thumbsup:
Zoe Callahan: :thumbsup:

Maya Ramos: All right, proceeding to start the deploy in 90s. I’ll post final status when canary completes.

DeployBot: job #55911: canary started at 6201234660, canary=5%

Maya Ramos: (final) canary passed gates at +12m, advancing to 25% now. Will watch metrics and post when at 100%.
